enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the whole addon on or off.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: What others see when they click "Profile" in the Freundeskreis wheel. Your birthday lives in "Calendar". Command: /steckbrief

share.name: Share profile
share.description: Other addon users can see your profile.

nickname.name: Name
nickname.description: What you want to be called.

age.name: Age
age.description: Type freely - leave empty if you don't want to show it.

mobPicker.name: Mob identity
mobPicker.description: Which Minecraft mob are you? Type to search.

country.name: Country
country.description: Type freely, e.g. Germany, USA, China, Japan …

openKeys.name: Keys: open your own profile
openKeys.description: Any key combination (one or more keys), only active in-game.

open.name: View your own profile
open.description: This is how others see your profile.

state.name: State / region
state.description: Type anything, e.g. Bavaria, Texas, Ontario …

statePicker.name: Pick German state
statePicker.description: All 16 German states to click. From another country? Just type it in above.

woodPicker.name: Wood frame
woodPicker.description: Wood type for your profile card frame. Click one to select it.

stickerBook.name: Sticker book
stickerBook.description: Give any player with the Freundeskreis addon your head as a sticker – no friendship needed, you just have to be on the same server. Uses LabyConnect, no chat message. Stickers you receive stay in your book forever. Command: /sammelbuch

inWheel.name: Show in wheel
inWheel.description: Shows "Give sticker" in the Freundeskreis ring – and afterwards "View sticker book".

accept.name: Accept stickers
accept.description: Other addon users can give you stickers.

openKeys.name: Keys: open sticker book
openKeys.description: Any key combination (one or more keys), only active in game.

share.name: Others may view my sticker book
share.description: Anyone who gave you a sticker can open your sticker book and see which stickers you have. Only head, name and date are transferred.

notebook.name: Notebook
notebook.description: Private notes about players – everyone you click or write a note about gets a book on the shelf. Command: /notizbuch

open.name: Open notebook
open.description: Opens the bookshelf with all your friends.

woodPicker.name: Wood type
woodPicker.description: Preview of all wood types for the shelf. Click one to select it.

openKeys.name: Keys: open notebook
openKeys.description: Any key combination (one or more keys), only active in game.

coins.name: Friendship coins
coins.description: Next to your LabyMod friends' names you see a coin showing how long you've been friends. Coin 1 right away, then a new one every 6 months – up to the 20th (Legendary).

enabled.name: Show coins
enabled.description: Shows the friendship coin to the right of your friends' names (never on yourself).

gallery.name: View coins
gallery.description: All 20 coins and when you get them.

hudWidget.name: Set up HUD widget
hudWidget.description: Opens LabyMod's widget editor. Look for "Next birthday" and drag it onto your screen.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: Your friends' birthdays: calendar, birthday notifications, a cake next to the name and a HUD widget. Command: /kalender

birthday.name: Your birthday
birthday.description: DD.MM. (e.g. 14.03.). After saving you have 10 minutes to fix it, then only every 30 days.

reminders.name: Birthday notifications
reminders.description: Get notified when a friend has their birthday – and on your own.

cake.name: Cake next to the name
cake.description: Whoever has their birthday gets a little cake next to their name all day.

openKeys.name: Keys: open calendar
openKeys.description: Any key combination (one or more keys), only active in-game.

album.name: Photo album
album.description: Glue your best screenshots into an album, with a frame and a short caption. Command: /fotoalbum

openKeys.name: Keys: open photo album
openKeys.description: Any key combination (one or more keys), only active in-game.

add.name: Add a photo
add.description: Your screenshots: right-click a picture → "Save to photo album".

share.name: Share photo album
share.description: Other addon users on your server can view your album through the wheel (smaller images).

inWheel.name: Show in wheel
inWheel.description: Shows "Photo album" in the Freundeskreis wheel.

vanish.name: Vanish
vanish.description: Hide any player just for yourself – invisible, even when all players are shown. Works on every Minecraft version. Bring them back from the Scroll of the Banished (/fk).

enabled.name: Vanish enabled
enabled.description: Off = everyone you hid is visible again.

openKeys.name: Hotkey: scroll
openKeys.description: Opens the Scroll of the Banished.

open.name: Scroll of the Banished
open.description: All hidden players – click a name to bring them back.

diary.name: Diary
diary.description: Your private diary with a leather cover. Only you can read it – unless you give someone your share code. Open it via /fk.

remind.name: Reminder on server join
remind.description: Shows "You have not written in your diary today" when you join a server and have not written yet.

askOnQuit.name: Ask when quitting
askOnQuit.description: Asks once whether you want to write an entry: on 1.21.11 right when the game closes, on other versions after you leave the server.

open.name: Open diary
open.description: Opens your diary on today's page.

cover.name: Design cover
cover.description: Choose the leather, a seam of gold or silver thread, or dye a white book yourself.

friendCode.name: Code of a shared diary
friendCode.description: Did someone give you their diary code? Enter it here.

openShared.name: Open shared diary
openShared.description: Opens the diary of the person whose code is entered above. They must be online on the same server.

mixtape.name: Mixtapes
mixtape.description: Your box of tapes: collect songs with your own label and a YouTube or Spotify link, put them into the recorder and give them to friends. The song is started through the link in your browser.

inWheel.name: Show in the ring
inWheel.description: Shows "Give mixtape" in the Freundeskreis ring.

acceptGifts.name: Accept tapes
acceptGifts.description: Other addon users may offer you tapes. You decide each time whether to accept.

background.name: Background
background.description: Pick the wood shown behind this menu.

match.name: Blockmatch
match.description: 100 questions about you: honesty, humour, play style and more. Afterwards the addon shows which players on the server tick like you. It is about friendship; only the match in percent is shown.

participate.name: Take part
participate.description: When on and your questionnaire is complete: if someone on the server searches for matching players, your answers are sent to their addon for comparison. Only the percentage is shown there.

open.name: Open Blockmatch
open.description: Opens the questionnaire or the result.

background.name: Background
background.description: Only for the dark "Classic" design: pick the wood shown behind the menu.

colors.name: Colour
colors.description: Blockmatch colour theme: pink, light blue, mint, lilac or the dark design with wood.

music.name: Music
music.description: Plays background music while Blockmatch is open.

volume.name: Music volume
volume.description: How loud the music in Blockmatch is, in percent.

inWheel.name: Show in the ring
inWheel.description: Shows "Blockmatch" in the Freundeskreis ring, so you can see how well you fit with a player.

loot.name: Daily chest
loot.description: Once a day you open a chest with 1 to 10 Holy Coins. Use them to unlock woods for the backgrounds and to buy in the sticker shop. Holy Coins exist only in this addon, they are free and cannot be bought.

daily.name: Open when joining a server
daily.description: Opens the chest by itself once a day, shortly after you joined a server.

shop.name: Sticker shop
shop.description: Every day four random mob stickers are on offer, the same for all players. You pay with Holy Coins from the daily chest, bought stickers go into your sticker book.

gallery.name: View all stickers
gallery.description: Shows all mob stickers to browse. Right-click switches to the holo variant.

wheel.title: Freundeskreis
wheel.empty: All entries are turned off in the settings.

diary.copyEmpty: Nothing written on this page yet

mixtape.ownFull: The box holds no more than %s songs of your own.

match.title: Blockmatch
match.searching: Looking for players on this server
match.nobody: Nobody fits right now. Other players need the addon, have to be on the same server and must have filled in the questionnaire.
match.best: You have the most in common with
match.st0: I tell friends the truth, even when it is uncomfortable.
match.st1: A secret someone trusts me with stays with me.
match.st2: I admit mistakes instead of looking for excuses.
match.st3: When something bothers me, I say so directly.
match.st4: A small white lie is fine with me if it harms no one.
match.st5: Someone who lied to me once has a hard time earning my trust back.
match.st6: I do not talk badly about friends behind their backs.
match.st7: I keep promises, even when it does not suit me.
match.st8: It matters to me that friends honestly say what they think of me.
match.st9: I stand by my friends, even when others are against them.
match.st10: I prefer a few close friends to many loose ones.
match.st11: I get in touch even when I do not need anything.
match.st12: When a friend is in trouble, I step in for them.
match.st13: I am honestly happy when a friend achieves something I did not.
match.st14: I get jealous quickly when friends spend a lot of time with others.
match.st15: I do not forget old friends just because new ones come along.
match.st16: In a group I make sure nobody is left out.
match.st17: For a good friend I sometimes skip something of my own.
match.st18: I would rather listen than talk a lot myself.
match.st19: I would rather write than talk in voice chat.
match.st20: Talking about feelings comes easily to me.
match.st21: I ask when I notice that someone is not doing well.
match.st22: Sometimes it takes me days to answer messages.
match.st23: In voice chat I am usually the one entertaining the group.
match.st24: I like deep conversations more than small talk.
match.st25: I say openly when I want to be left alone for a while.
match.st26: When someone tells me about their problems, I look for a solution right away.
match.st27: After an argument I take the first step.
match.st28: I can apologise without it being hard for me.
match.st30: I get loud quickly in an argument.
match.st32: I can let a different opinion stand without having to be right.
match.st33: When I am angry, I need distance before I talk.
match.st34: I accept criticism without being offended.
match.st35: An argument is no reason for me to end a friendship.
match.st37: Sarcasm is part of a good conversation for me.
match.st38: I like to tease friends a little, and they may do the same to me.
match.st39: I am in a good mood most of the time.
match.st40: I do not find jokes at the expense of others funny.
match.st41: I often fool around, even when things should be serious.
match.st42: I do not take a bad mood out on others.
match.st44: I notice quickly when a joke goes too far.
match.st45: I would rather build than fight.
match.st46: I would rather play in a team than alone.
match.st48: I plan a project thoroughly before I start.
match.st49: When I lose, I stay relaxed.
match.st50: I stick with a project for a long time instead of always starting new ones.
match.st51: It matters to me that a build looks good and does not just work.
match.st52: I would rather explore the world than stay in one place.
match.st53: I follow server rules even when nobody is watching.
match.st54: I am on time when we have arranged to meet.
match.st55: I cancel in good time when I cannot make it.
match.st56: I like playing best in the evening or at night.
match.st57: School, training or work come before playing for me.
match.st58: I would rather plan my week than decide spontaneously.
match.st59: I am online almost every day.
match.st60: What I start, I also finish.
match.st61: I need fixed times without a screen.
match.st62: You can rely on me when it counts.
match.st63: I share my items without asking for anything in return.
match.st64: I patiently explain to beginners how something works.
match.st65: I ask for help myself when I am stuck.
match.st66: I help even when I had something else planned.
match.st67: Those who take should also give back.
match.st68: I notice when someone needs help before they ask.
match.st69: When someone takes advantage of my help, I say so clearly.
match.st70: Achieving something together matters more to me than my own progress.
match.st71: I say thank you, even for small things.
match.st72: I feel comfortable in large groups.
match.st73: I need a lot of time to myself.
match.st74: I like getting to know new people.
match.st75: Loud, crowded servers wear me out.
match.st76: I like being the centre of attention.
match.st77: I prefer playing with the same few people.
match.st78: New things make me curious rather than unsure.
match.st79: I need variety, otherwise I get bored quickly.
match.st80: I approach unknown players on my own.
match.st81: I set goals and work towards them.
match.st82: I often compare myself with others.
match.st83: When something does not work, I keep trying until it does.
match.st84: I think a lot about the future.
match.st85: It matters to me to keep getting better.
match.st86: Fairness matters more to me than success.
match.st87: I decide with my gut rather than my head.
match.st88: I stand by my opinion, even when I am alone with it.
match.st89: I am content with what I have.
match.fun0: Your first Minecraft day: what do you do first?
match.fun0o0: Collect as much wood as possible
match.fun0o2: Straight into a cave for stone and iron
match.fun1: The first night is coming. Do you seal yourself into a dirt hut?
match.fun1o0: Sure, close the hole and wait
match.fun1o1: No, I build something proper right away
match.fun1o2: Absolutely not, I fight my way through
match.fun2o0: The villager with a fixed stall
match.fun2o1: The wandering trader who shows up when nobody needs him
match.fun2o2: The barterer in the Nether: gold first, then we talk
match.fun3o1: Secure everything first and fetch the Fortune pickaxe
match.fun3o2: Note the coordinates and come back later
match.fun4: What does your storage look like?
match.fun4o2: Wherever I stand, a chest goes down
match.fun5o2: I notice it too late, as always
match.fun6: Your first visit to the Nether:
match.fun6o1: Just go, it will be fine
match.fun7o0: A cobblestone cube, that will do
match.fun7o1: Lovingly built, with a roof and a garden
match.fun8: Night falls and you have no bed with you.
match.fun8o2: Pillar up and wait for morning
match.fun9: How do you prefer to travel?
match.fun9o2: On foot, you see more that way
